newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Liton up sharply at mid-session.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Liton up sharply at mid-session.

text.p: Taiwan's Liton Electronic Co Ltd rose sharply in late trade on Wednesday, reflecting a sound nine-month earnings report for the company, brokers said.
With 30 minutes left, Liton was up 3.41 percent or T$1.40 to T$42.50 in heavy trade of 27.87 million shares.

Liton said earlier on Wednesday net profit from January to September 1996 rose to T$593 million from T$530 million in the same 1995 period. Nine-month sales revenue also rose to T$7.653 billion from T$6.6 billion in the same 1995 period.
"Most of the trading today reflects the earnings reports of various firms, and Liton's healthy figures attracted investor interest," said Michael Hung of Nikko Securities.
The deadline for listed companies to report earnings for the first three quarters is October 31.
